versions.changelog:
Initial release of spraay-trust.

- Free address safety screening for phishing, sanctions, exploits, and mixers
- Free token risk checks including honeypot detection, sell tax, blacklists
- Free EVM transaction decoding to human-readable form
- Paid multi-dimensional agent trust scores (ProofLayer) for safer payments and escrow decisions
- Uses only the user-configured SPRAAY_GATEWAY_URL, requires no API key
- Designed for safe agent-to-agent commerce with clear pre-payment workflows
